name: @kickside/webhooks-ui
title: KickSide Webhooks
description: Webhook management web component for kickside/webhooks, over the native webhook mint/list/revoke API.

wippy.description: Webhook management web components for kickside/webhooks — one build producing three elements: kickside-webhooks (index.js), the full management surface that lists minted webhooks over GET /api/v1/webhooks and opens a detail modal to rename, edit the payload JSON-schema, copy the ingress URL, revoke, and delete; kickside-webhook-create (create.js), the flush create form that mints a webhook via POST /api/v1/webhooks and reveals the secret and ingress URL exactly once; and kickside-webhook-detail (detail.js), a read-only panel showing a selected webhook's public ingress URL and payload schema. The management and create views fetch their own data and take no attributes (wippy.props is empty); the detail element receives the selected webhook on its value or config attribute, either a bare id or a JSON object string {thread_id}. The create element emits created (detail {id, thread_id, webhook_id, title}) only when the user presses Done after the one-time secret reveal, close ({}) when dismissed, and error ({message, error}) on a failed mint — the generic component-picker create path listens for created/close. Per-tag registry entries live in platform/webhooks/src/_index.yaml.
